purpose: Define repeatable, legal targeted Android ADB captures for promoting missing JCC live_state fields without guessing.

privacy_policy.account_data_policy: Do not collect private account identity, credentials, payment, auth, token, cookie, or contact data.

diff_policy.promotion_policy: Only promote changed candidates into live_state after local_chair_id binding and a focused verifier prove field semantics.

scenarios.goal: Capture match lifecycle start, foreground package, emulator profile, source freshness, and early set/mode hints.
capture_steps: Start capture before queue/loading transition.
Run foreground package and dumpsys window/activity snapshots.
Pull public external net logs after GameStart appears.
success_criteria: GameStart or equivalent evidence is present.
Each promoted field has evidence and freshness metadata.
reject_if: Evidence requires private app data, memory reads, or anti-cheat bypass.

scenarios.goal: Bind local player/chair at the start of every match and prevent prior-match chair reuse.
capture_steps: Capture from opening minion/first round until first player life report.
Record local report, chair, and player life evidence after GameStart.
Compare against previous match window to ensure no chair leakage.
success_criteria: hp evidence is filtered by bound local_chair_id.
reject_if: Evidence reuses a chair from a previous GameStart.

scenarios.goal: Capture planning/shop economy, board, bench, traits, and shop transitions after player actions.
capture_steps: Capture baseline at start of planning.
Buy one shop unit, move one unit between board and bench, and optionally sell one unit.
Manually roll once only if gold is visible/known, then capture the delta.
success_criteria: Changed board/bench/shop/economy fields produce candidate signal evidence.
Promotion keeps local_chair_id binding and does not infer unchanged fields.
reject_if: Evidence depends on process modification, memory injection, or private account data.

scenarios.goal: Capture combat state, opponent pairing, result, damage, income, and remaining units.
capture_steps: Capture immediately before combat starts.
Capture during combat for pairing/result/damage signals; do not promote visible opponent-board units from current-view data.
Capture after result, damage, and income resolve.
success_criteria: Opponent chair and result evidence are from the active match window.
Damage/income evidence is not promoted to total hp/gold unless separately proven.
reject_if: Evidence requires anti-cheat bypass or hidden process memory.

scenarios.goal: Capture augment choice UI/options and selected augment.
capture_steps: Pause on augment selection screen before choosing.
Capture option IDs/text/icons and reroll count if present.
Capture after selecting one augment.
success_criteria: Each choice has slot/id or OCR/user fallback evidence.
Selected augment is linked to the post-choice delta.
reject_if: Names are guessed without ID/OCR/user evidence.

scenarios.goal: Capture item drops, item bench, equipped items, anvils, and reward choices.
capture_steps: Capture before a loot/item reward resolves.
Capture after orbs/anvils/items appear on bench.
Equip one item and capture the holder/item delta.
success_criteria: Item bench and equipped item evidence are separated.
Reward choices are not promoted unless options are observed.
reject_if: Evidence depends on process modification, memory injection, anti-cheat bypass, private data, or non-user-authorized cache access.

scenarios.goal: Capture carousel availability, units, items, positions, pick state, and selected pick.
capture_steps: Capture when carousel stage starts.
Capture while units/items are visible and before picking.
Capture immediately after selected pick resolves.
success_criteria: Available carousel units/items carry evidence per entry.
Selected pick is tied to a post-pick delta.
reject_if: Evidence requires private account data or anti-cheat bypass.

scenarios.goal: Capture match end, final result, and stale-state boundary.
capture_steps: Capture immediately before final combat resolves.
Capture postgame/result screen.
Start a new lobby/loading baseline to verify prior match state is stale.
success_criteria: match_end evidence gates player-specific strategy state.
Stale fields are reported rather than reused.
reject_if: Evidence requires private account scraping or process modification.
